text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, which song will you celebrate with 
next, Earth-san?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You're right! In that case, let's go with 
a bittersweet ballad inspired by 
Fukukitaru-san...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait a moment! While I did say 
today's Fuku's Lucky Song was the birthday 
song――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You've played so many songs for me in a 
row, I'm honestly starting to feel a bit 
bad about taking up your time~~..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about that at 
all! Because right now, at this very 
moment, I've already received your return 
gift.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
One of the most beautiful ritmos on this 
earth, an anima swaying to the musica— 
That would be your eyes, amore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, you'll let me celebrate you more, 
won't you? Gattina.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. Well, if you insist that much, 
maybe I'll let you celebrate for me...!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Heh, a flawless stalling tactic, if I do 
say so myself—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Tannhauser-san.\nI'm counting on you to 
decorate the venue...!)
